minutes.title: Meeting Recap
minutes.summary: The meeting reviewed functional design requirements, discussed control types and features, decided on target market, and assigned tasks. Next steps include finalizing designs and preparing marketing materials.
decisions: The product will aim at the 15 to 35 bracket
Include new features apart from the most basic stuff possible.
We'll use David's proposal of three categories: audio control, video control, and device functions

actions.task: Recap previous meeting and discuss functional design requirements
Recap on aiming the product at the 15 to 35 bracket and actual functions
Pull minutes into project documents folder
